messages:
neha: Heads-up: p99 for /v1/chat (widget-route) jumped ~250ms in staging after yesterday's routing tweak. p50/p95 stable. anyone debugged yet?
ben: saw it. looks scoped to the widget-route sub-endpoint. sample_count dropped a lot at the same time (~180 -> 12).
rachel: small-N noise is the usual suspect, but i pulled spans and the extra latency is almost entirely network/transport. traces show an unexpected proxy hop for some clients.
neha: do we clearly show transport vs service in the latency card? the panel mixes origins so it's easy to miss.
ben: we show transport/service split but the rollup aggregates origins. proposal: surface an "origin slice" selector (ingress/proxy/backend) so users can compute p99 by origin.
metrics-bot: Task created: MET-314 - add origin filter param to /metrics/percentiles API.
rachel: also add a confidence indicator when N < 50 (e.g., amber badge: "low sample - p99 may be unstable"). quick wins only: tooltip change showing sample_count and top origin.
neha: love that. small UX ask: when a rollout changes route weights, show a one-line note: "small cohorts may see percentile jumps" with link to per-origin view.\b en: typo? ben: lol. agree with UX. i'll open a small PR for tooltip + API param.
ana: FYI opened infra ticket INF-789 to check why routing tweak promoted proxy path for certain client prefixes.
neha: for triage, here's a quick repro loop to force the widget-route path: `for i in 1..300; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{time_total}\n" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat?route=widget-test"; done | sort -n | tail -n 20`
rachel: once tooltip + origin param exist we can automate alerts to ignore p99 pages when sample_count < 30 or show info-only notification.
metrics-bot: Noted. MET-314 assigned to ben. INF-789 linked.
neha: cool. let's land tooltip first then follow with API and alerting tweak. will monitor staging for 24h after deploy. :thumbsup:
